title: [Arch Linux/Wayland] Vulkan Swap Chain Error causing intermittent stuttering/lag
body:
### Tested versions

-4.6.1 stable
latest master -4.7.dev

### System information

godot ver 4.7.dev Linuxbsd on Arch Linux x86_64, kernel 6.19.8-arch1-1, niri 25.11 wm (Wayland), Intel i7-9700K CPU, NVIDIA GTX 1070 GPU

### Issue description

Have been seeing variations of the following across multiple versions from godot 4.6.1 stable to now the latest master which I compiled locally as v4.7.dev.custom_build.1eb0374e5:

`ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: false
   at: _determine_swap_chain_format (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3444)
ERROR: Surface did not return any valid formats.
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3705)
ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: false`

Error was encountered in both forward+ and mobile rendering profiles. Did not seem to occur in compatibility mode. I have also experienced some random crashes which seem related via timing but mostly I've just encountered large frame lag associated with the error message. Occurs intermittently while in the editor or while running. I am in single window mode as I cannot seem to get the game to embed in the editor window even with all the settings checked. I suspect that may be because of my window manager (niri) but unclear.

Here is a full log of a single short session launched via my terminal. All I did was fly around in the editor scene view and move the camera a few times:

### Steps to reproduce

Just run the engine with a basic 3d scene with a cube mesh, camera and light. Move the camera or the cube.
